headline: Community Preservation Committee projects at Balch Playground, Holcroft Park, Gillis Park, Ahearn Park, and Obear Park.
summary: Updates will cover Round 12, 13, and 14 applications, including equipment orders and court replacement bids. Commission members will also give reports on golf and tennis, preservation, and open space.
items: Assistant director's report: past months' summary and upcoming classes and events
Director's report: recent and upcoming events, correspondence, and budget and enterprise fund updates
Round 12 projects: Balch Playground Phase 2 (Cummings donation), Holcroft Park splashpad update, Gillis Park pavilion
Round 13 applications for Ahearn Park, Bartlett Gardens, and Gillis Basketball: equipment orders and bids for court replacements
Round 14 applications for Obear Park, Cooney Field, and McPherson Youth Center: all deemed eligible to submit full applications
Other projects: Abbott St. ROW and Independence Park
Ongoing projects such as Gillis Park entrance, AEDs, and Beverly in Bloom, plus Lynch Park resiliency and other park repairs
Questions and answers with commission members
Commission reports from the Beverly Golf & Tennis Commission, Community Preservation Committee, and Open Space & Recreation Committee
location: Beverly Senior Center (90 Colon Street, Beverly)
